publication.title: Expediting knowledge acquisition by a web framework for Knowledge Graph Exploration and Visualization (KGEV): case studies on COVID-19 and Human Phenotype Ontology

source_reading.scope: Abstract continuation, complete Methods, Results/interface and three search cases, HPO adaptation, Discussion/limitations and availability. Reference list not read integrally.

adjudication.basis: KGEV implements direct interactive exploration, filtering, neighborhood and path search on a biomedical knowledge graph, with linked text/article evidence. The report demonstrates COVID-19 and HPO use cases; it does not establish a recruited user trial or measured interactive-efficiency improvement.

codes.notes: KGEV actual runtime is Neo4j property graph, not native RDF endpoint. Evidence relations may merely mention/challenge claims; confidence filters are not causal certainty. Import counts include texts/documents.
